problem:
The joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ for the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ is given below.

| $f$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=1$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $X=1$ | $0.1$ | $0.2$ |
| $X=2$ | $0.3$ | $0.4$ |

Given that $\text{E}[X]=1.7$ and $\text{E}[Y]=0.6,$ find the covariance matrix for $X$ and $Y.$
